[Intro]
[Ebm]

[Verse 1]
[Ebm]Warm yourself by the [B]fire, son, And the
[Db]morning will come soon. [Abm]
[Ebm]I'll tell you stories of a [B]better time, In a
[Gb]place that we once knew. [Ebm]
[Ebm]Before we packed our bags And [B]left all this behind
[Db]us in the dust, [Abm]
[Ebm]We had a place that we could [B]call home, And a life
[Gb]no one could touch.
[Ebm]Don't hold me

[Chorus]
[Ebm]up now, I can stand my
[Gb]own ground, I don't need your
[Db]help now, You will let me
[B]down, down, down! Don't hold me
[Ebm]up now, I can stand my
[Gb]own ground, I don't need your
[Db]help now, You will let me
[B]down, down, down! Down!
[Ebm]

[Verse 2]
[Ebm]We are the angry and the [B]desperate, The hung-
[Db]ry, and the cold, [Abm]
[Ebm]We are the ones who kept [B]quiet, And always did
[Gb]what we were told. [Ebm]
[Ebm]But we've been sweating while you [B]slept so calm, In the
[Db]safety of your home. [Abm]
[Ebm]We've been pulling out the [B]nails that hold up Eve-
[Gb]rything you've known.
[Ebm]Don't hold me

[Chorus]
[Ebm]up now, I can stand my
[Gb]own ground, I don't need your
[Db]help now, You will let me
[B]down, down, down! Don't hold me
[Ebm]up now, I can stand my
[Gb]own ground, I don't need your
[Db]help now, You will let me
[B]down, down, down!

[Interlude]
[Abm]So open your
[Gb]eyes child, Let's be on our
[Abm]way. Broken windows and
[Gb]ashes Are guiding the
[Abm]way. Keep quiet no
[Gb]longer, We'll sing through the
[E]day, Of the lives that we've
[Ebm]lost, And the lives we've re-
[B]claimed. [Gb][Db]Go!
